about.title: How it works
about.sliders: Each slider is a school subject. Set it to your grade from 1 to 10, the Dutch school scale: 6 or more is a pass.
about.floors: The five floors are the levels of education in the Netherlands. After primary school, pupils go to vmbo, havo or vwo, and from there on to:
about.floor.0: work you can start without a diploma; you learn on the job.
about.floor.1: vocational school (mbo) levels 2-3: learn a trade in 2-3 years, often partly at work.
about.floor.2: the highest vocational level, 3-4 years; it can lead on to hbo.
about.floor.3: hogeschool, a university of applied sciences: practical higher education, after havo, vwo or mbo 4.
about.floor.4: universiteit, a research university: the most theory, after vwo (or via hbo).
about.states: Open: your grades are enough. Nearly there (+N): N more points on the sliders would open it. Locked (🔒): still too far for now.
about.goal: Tap a profession and choose ‘This is my goal’: the sliders then mark with ⚑ what your goal needs, and the top of the page shows what is still missing.
about.demo: All numbers are demo data for now: made up for this prototype and approximate, not real admission rules and not advice.
about.privacy: Privacy: the page itself stores nothing and sends nothing. The hosting provider serves the files and sees an ordinary page request, but never your grades or your goal: they live in the address after the #, and that part is not sent.

route.about.intro: This page is for years 1 to 3 of secondary school, before you choose a profile. Pick your school level and, if you already know it, your profile.
route.about.doors: Each door is a profession: the same 36 as on the pages for groep 6-8. They stand together by kind of work, with no top and no bottom.
route.about.states: Open: your level and profile lead there directly. One step more: one extra step gets you there, and the door says which: an extra subject in your profile, mbo 2 first (from bb) or mbo 4 first (from vmbo-gl/tl), moving up a level after your diploma, or a first year of hbo. While you have not chosen a profile, the step can also be: choose one of these profiles. Not on this route: it needs another level or profile, and the door says which. Nothing is closed for good.
route.about.profiles: Havo and vwo have four profiles. While you have not chosen one, you see what your level alone decides, and on each profile how many doors it opens. If your profile does not admit you to an hbo or wo programme, that door is closed and names the profiles that do: from havo or vwo, the way via mbo 4 is not one extra step.
route.about.vmbo: Real vmbo has ten profiles; to keep it simple, this page shows four broad directions. Any vmbo diploma gets you into mbo: your direction closes no door, it only says what fits best.
route.about.bbkb: For vmbo-bb/kb the page follows the basic track (bb), the stricter of the two. With kb you can go straight to mbo 4, and via mbo 4 on to hbo.
route.about.demo: The admission rules by profile for hbo and wo are checked against the Dutch admission regulation (Ratho) of 1 September 2026. Which programme stands for each profession is our own choice, and a programme can still ask for more, such as a test or a selection. Everything else here is still demo data: made up for this prototype and approximate, not advice.
route.about.privacy: Privacy: the page itself stores nothing and sends nothing. The hosting provider serves the files and sees an ordinary page request, but never your level or profile: they live in the address after the #, and that part is not sent.
